svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 85 mm of 20 mm bright steel round bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a 1 mm chamfer on both ends so it starts into the holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a small flat 10 mm long at each collar position (12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 79 mm from the outer end) for the collar set screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit, from outside to inside: outer collar, upright, axle plate,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: PTFE thrust washer, yoke plate, inner collar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The axle does not turn: the yoke plate turns on it, greased.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it slides through the drilled upright and plate by hand.
